intentionalChanges: An owned cancellable controller replaces detached Go goroutines; actor shutdown cancels an accepted pre-disconnect delay, waits bounded provider operations, and prevents ownerless cloud actions. Embedded libraries receive explicit provider authority; only the standalone launcher reads cloud credentials.

Duration accumulation refuses arithmetic overflow rather than reproducing Go's pathological unsigned wrap where two 2^63-nanosecond components plus10m become10m. Ordinary positive/negative i64 nanosecond limits and documented fractional syntax remain compatible; invalid wrapped input cannot enable automatic stop.

The provider bounds credential files and response bodies, refuses redirects and invalid host coordinate characters, and sanitizes provider errors. No caller can select an endpoint or pass provider credentials.
